neighbours.label: ' up' in 'stay up' (staying awake late; also 'stay up to date')
fire: On Fridays the teenagers like to stay up past two in the morning.
Grandma tried to stay up for the New Year countdown but fell asleep.
Follow our page to stay up to date on road closures.
If you stay up all night studying, you'll be exhausted tomorrow.
The nurses had to stay up with the sick child until dawn.
We stayed up late talking about old times.
Can I stay up and watch the end of the game?
Many fans stayed up to watch the launch live.
quiet: Most teenagers only wake up around noon on weekends.
Grandpa tried to keep awake for the countdown but dozed off.
Sign up to our page for news about road closures.
If you give up studying now, you'll regret it tomorrow.
The nurses had to sit with the sick child until dawn.
We cleaned up the kitchen after talking about old times.
Can I turn up the volume for the end of the game?
Many fans showed up early to watch the launch.
